---
title: "Welcome"
---

This documentation ships inside the **rsdocs** R package and is opened
from the RStudio *Addins* menu.

## What is in here

- [Getting started](guide/getting-started.qmd) - installing and opening the addins

## How it is served

The site is rendered once at build time and copied to `inst/docs/`. The
addin starts a small local web server and RStudio Server proxies it to
your browser.
